title: ぼくが朝、起こす理由
theme: 犬の1年は人の何年分にもなる。だから毎朝の散歩を急かしてしまう

slides.text:
ぼくが毎朝、
あなたを起こす理由
slides.scene: Early morning: the dog stands on its hind legs at the bedside, front paws on the duvet, looking eagerly at the viewer; soft dawn light.
slides.shot: centered, the dog clearly in view, a sleeping shape under the duvet

slides.text:
あなたは朝、
いつも少しだけ眠そう
slides.scene: A cozy bed in morning light, the owner a lump under a duvet with only messy dark hair on the pillow visible from behind.
slides.shot: from the foot of the bed

slides.text:
「あと5分」と言って、
布団にもぐる
slides.scene: The owner's hand pulls the duvet over their head; the dog sits on the bed watching patiently.
slides.shot: from the side of the bed

slides.text:
でもぼくは、待ちきれなくて
鼻でつつくんだ
slides.scene: The dog nudges the duvet-covered shoulder with its nose, tail up.
slides.shot: close-up of the dog's nose against the duvet

slides.text:
知ってる？ぼくの1年は、
あなたの何年分もあるんだ
slides.scene: The dog sits by the bedroom window at sunrise, looking back at the viewer with gentle wise eyes.
slides.shot: medium shot, sunrise light

slides.text:
だから今朝の散歩道も、
ぼくにはとても大事
slides.scene: The dog waits by the door holding its light-blue leash in its mouth, tail wagging.
slides.shot: low angle in the entrance

slides.text:
金木犀のにおいが、
してきたでしょう？
slides.scene: A quiet residential walking path lined with blooming osmanthus trees with tiny orange flowers; the dog lifts its nose to sniff the air.
slides.shot: wide view of the path, the dog small in the frame

slides.text:
ぼくはもう、
この季節を3回知っている
slides.scene: Three small vignettes on one page: the dog as a tiny puppy, a young dog, and now, each sniffing orange osmanthus flowers.
slides.shot: three small vignettes side by side

slides.text:
あなたは笑って、
リードを手にとった
slides.scene: The owner's hand lifts the light-blue leash from its hook; the dog spins happily below.
slides.shot: close-up of hand and leash, the dog below

slides.text:
いつもより少し遠回りして、
川ぞいの道を歩いた
slides.scene: A calm riverside path on a sunny early-autumn morning; the owner, seen from behind in an oatmeal knit sweater and grey pants with empty hands except the leash, walks the dog on a light-blue leash.
slides.shot: wide view from behind

slides.text:
あなたの歩くはやさに、
ぼくは合わせるのがうまい
slides.scene: On a sunny morning path, the dog trots right beside the owner's white sneakers, looking up at them. The owner carries nothing but the light-blue leash.
slides.shot: low angle at ground level, owner's legs only

slides.text:
ときどき振り返ると、
ちゃんとあなたがいる
slides.scene: On a sunny morning path, the dog looks back over its shoulder; a few steps behind, the owner's legs in grey pants and white sneakers. No umbrella, no bag.
slides.shot: from behind the dog, low angle

slides.text:
それだけで、
しっぽが勝手に動くんだ
slides.scene: Close-up of the dog's fluffy curled tail wagging, fallen osmanthus flowers on the ground.
slides.shot: close-up of the tail and ground

slides.text:
ぼくの世界は、
あなたでできている
slides.scene: The dog sits on the riverside grass looking up adoringly at the owner's hand reaching down to it.
slides.shot: close-up of the dog looking up, the hand entering from the top

slides.text:
あなたには、
仕事も友だちもあるけれど
slides.scene: On the sunny riverside path, the owner in an oatmeal knit sweater stands looking at a phone, seen from behind; the dog sits patiently at their feet. No umbrella, no bag, no coat.
slides.shot: from behind at a distance

slides.text:
ぼくの一生は、
あなたの一生の少しだけ
slides.scene: The dog sitting alone on the riverbank watching the gentle flowing water in soft morning light, calm and peaceful.
slides.shot: wide, quiet, the dog seen from behind

slides.text:
その少しを、
ぜんぶあなたと歩きたい
slides.scene: Sunny morning: the owner's hand holds the light-blue leash, the dog walks alongside; their two shadows side by side on the path. No umbrella, no bag.
slides.shot: low angle, shadows on the path

slides.text:
明日の朝も、
玄関で待っているね
slides.scene: The dog lying on the entrance mat with the leash beside it, chin on paws, content and hopeful.
slides.shot: low angle in the entrance

slides.text:
眠くても、
少しだけ付き合ってね
slides.scene: The dog curled up at the foot of the bed at night, one eye open looking at the viewer.
slides.shot: close-up at the foot of the bed

slides.text:
明日の散歩は、
少しだけ遠回りしてみませんか？
slides.scene: The next morning: the owner, seen from behind in an oatmeal knit sweater, opens the front door to golden sunlight; the dog steps out first, tail up. No umbrella, no bag, no coat.
slides.shot: from behind the owner at the doorway

caption:
ぼくの一生は、あなたの一生の少しだけ。
明日の散歩、少しだけ遠回りしてあげてください。
youtube_title: ぼくが毎朝、あなたを起こす理由
self_review: 犬の十戒のテーマ（寿命の短さ）だけを借り、原文は使っていない。死や別れの語はなく、16枚目の『一生の少しだけ』で時間の差を示すだけ。結末は散歩の遠回りという前向きな行動。
